parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The production copy of `DebugMetricsProvider.init` in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`) is the authoritative definition; the `DebugHUD.swift` copy is a demonstration fixture that intentionally mirrors it for the WallpaperSampleApp context. Consolidating these would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
